notes: Source: Costco Wholesale 10-Q filed 2026-03-11 for fiscal Q2 2026 (period 2025-11-24 to 2026-02-15, CIK 0000909832, accession 0000909832-26-000029).
Revenue is total revenue (net sales $68,242M + membership fees $1,355M = $69,597M) for the 12-week quarter.
Net income and total assets are directly reported quarterly figures from XBRL (frame CY2026Q1 / CY2026Q1I).

Cash flow statement is presented YTD in 10-Q filings; Q2 standalone OCF ($2,996M) and CapEx ($1,289M) derived by subtracting Q1 FY2026 values (from 10-Q filed 2025-12-17, accession 0000909832-25-000169) from H1 YTD values.
Capital expenditures represent additions to property and equipment, treated as positive cash outflow.
